description: This is a server-side module for a SvelteKit page handling user and team management in a Django-based backend, implementing load functions and actions for CRUD operations and API interactions.

methods.name: apiRequest
methods.description: Makes authenticated API requests to the Django backend, handling errors and adding necessary headers.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and prepares user and team data for the page, including permission checks.

methods.name: add_user
methods.description: Handles adding a new user to the organization via API.

methods.name: edit_role
methods.description: Handles changing a user's role within the organization.

methods.name: remove_user
methods.description: Removes (deactivates) a user from the organization.

methods.name: create_team
methods.description: Creates a new team with specified users.

methods.name: update_team
methods.description: Updates details of an existing team.
